messages:
zara-sdk: quick heads-up - hitting inconsistent cancellation semantics between our Retrofit suspend adapter and OkHttp on emulators (API 29/30).

mike-android: what do you mean by inconsistent? request still running after coroutine cancel?

zara-sdk: yeah. app calls with withTimeout(1200) -> continuation resumes cancelled -> we call call.cancel() in adapter but OkHttp shows runningCall for several seconds, causing dispatcher saturation under load.

olga-qa: seen that pattern in e2e flakies. can you share minimal repro?

zara-sdk: minimal: 
```
withTimeout(1200) { api.predict(input) } // suspend
```
Adapter does: enqueue(call) and onCancellation { call.cancel() }

zara-sdk: logs: 
```
I/Coroutine: cancelled by timeout
I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/predict
I/OkHttp: <-- 200 (4s later)
```
So coroutine cancels but http still finishes.

mike-android: this is often due to the remote server finishing the request body write or native socket not interrupting immediately. two pragmatic fixes: (1) propagate coroutine deadline into OkHttp per-call timeout before enqueue, (2) add a small post-cancel poll that checks dispatcher.runningCalls and forces shutdown if too many.

olga-qa: option (2) sounds brittle. prefer (1) + test coverage across API 28-34.

zara-sdk: I prototyped an adapter change that sets call.timeout().timeout(remainingMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) when a coroutine timed deadline exists. also on cancellation we still call call.cancel().

mike-android: nice, that should make OkHttp fail fast even if the native socket lingers. just be careful on HTTP/2 where per-stream timeouts behave differently. add unit tests that simulate streaming body to ensure we don't introduce regressions.

olga-qa: I'll add emulator-matrix job that exercises withTimeout cancellations and asserts no OkHttp runningCalls > 200ms after coroutine cancel under modest load.

ci-bot: queued job emulator-deadline-propagation (id 8341).

zara-sdk: will open a PR with adapter change + small harness and docs snippet showing extension usage.

mike-android: also add a note in the Java SDK docs showing the equivalent pattern using Call.timeout() so parity is explicit.

olga-qa: assigning flaky test task to me. will report results in the PR before merge.

zara-sdk: filing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-kotlin/issues/1450 - PR incoming.
